proof_body:
by
  intro r hr
  have : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure r) := ProbabilityTheory.isProbabilityMeasure_expMeasure hr
  have tail : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure r).real (Set.Ioi x) = Real.exp (-(r * x)) := by
    intro x hx
    have h := ProbabilityTheory.cdf_expMeasure_eq hr x
    rw [if_pos hx, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real] at h
    have hc : (Set.Ioi x) = (Set.Iic x)ᶜ := by ext; simp
    rw [hc, MeasureTheory.probReal_compl_eq_one_sub measurableSet_Iic, h]
    ring
  refine ⟨tail, fun s t hs ht => ?_⟩
  have hinter : Set.Ioi s ∩ Set.Ioi (s + t) = Set.Ioi (s + t) := by
    ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Ioi]; constructor
    · exact fun h => h.2
    · exact fun h => ⟨by linarith, h⟩
  rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ProbabilityTheory.cond_apply measurableSet_Ioi, hinter, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, ← MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, tail s hs, tail (s + t) (by linarith), tail t ht, mul_add, neg_add, Real.exp_add]
  have := Real.exp_pos (-(r * s))
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure r).real (Set.Ioi x) = Real.exp (-(r * x))) ∧ ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ t → (ProbabilityTheory.cond (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure r) (Set.Ioi s)).real (Set.Ioi (s + t)) = (ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure r).real (Set.Ioi t)
